name: anchor
description: Anchor hosts and shares the artifacts Cursor builds. Ask Cursor for an app, an interactive presentation, or a document that runs on live data from SQL tables and MCP servers, or have it publish any HTML, Markdown (MD), SVG, PNG, or MP4 file. Each one stays private, shared only with the people you pick. Sign in once, with no API keys. Cursor only touches what you can access.
